data.long_meaning: The meaning of Adelphus is recorded in name-lists as “Brother, Companion”. This meaning has NOT been verified against a classical lexical or onomastic source, so it is published as an unverified candidate only. The record is flagged for manual source verification.
data.spiritual_meaning: Adelphus expresses “Brother, Companion”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Adelphus total 32, reducing to 5. Number 5 is associated with freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_hebrew.name: אדלפוס
in_hebrew.long_meaning: אדלפוס הוא שם הנגזר מהמילה היוונית אחים, ומשמעותו היא אחים במובן רוחני, המתייחס לאחווה הנוצרית ולקהילת המאמינים

in_greek.name: Αδελφός
in_greek.long_meaning: Αδελφός είναι ο όρος που χρησιμοποιείται για να περιγράψει τους αδελφούς εν πνεύματι, και σημαίνει την αλληλεγγύη και την αγάπη μεταξύ των μελών της χριστιανικής κοινότητας

in_latin.name: Adelphus
in_latin.long_meaning: Adelphus est nomen quod derivatur a verbo graeco fratres, et significat fratres in spiritu, referens ad communionem et caritatem inter fideles in ecclesia christiana
